text:
maria: Heads-up — ACME Health wants private VPC rollout in staging next Tue. Need status on cross-connect, firewall rules, and client certs. Who owns end-to-end?

josh: I can own the network side; currently waiting on their NOC to confirm fiber handoff window. I asked for the handoff window yesterday, no reply yet.

ankit: I'll take infra-side (deploy + image prep). Still finishing the air-gapped bootstrap script; should be done today but need a quick review.

emma: I have customer onboarding tasks: they need the CA cert bundle and the RBAC mapping. @maria can you confirm the usernames they provided match our template?

maria: Confirmed the usernames except one mismatch (acme-svc -> acme-service). I'll send updated CSV by EOD.

josh: Networking checklist (short):
- WAN connection confirmed? not yet.
- BGP peering details from customer? pending.
- Firewall ACLs pre-approved? yes, got ACLs but need target IPs.

ankit: Air-gap blocker: installer assumes internet to fetch deps. Adding an option to load vendor tarballs from USB/NFS. Quick diff:
```bash
-- original: curl https://packages/... 
++ airgap: tar -xvf /mnt/vendor/packages.tar.gz
```
Need SRE to validate NFS mount approach.

sre-oncall: We prefer s3 sync into local minio for staging. NFS is OK but flaky for concurrent installs. If you go NFS, add retry logic and checksum verify.

emma: Certs: I generated CSR and uploaded to our internal CA. @maria can you push the signed cert to S3 path /acme/certs/staging/? Customer needs the client cert as well.

maria: Done — pushed signed server cert. Client cert pending customer CSR. I also updated the runbook with the expected filenames. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/acme-staging

josh: Quick ask — can infra stub a fallback model variant for low-memory hosts? Not strictly networking but impacts the deployment sizing. @ankit

ankit: Yes, I'll add a small-quantized variant and set the rollout policy to fallback to it if OOM or GPU unavailable. Will push canary config in PR later today.

maria: Summary of open items: 1) Customer NOC to confirm handoff window (josh) 2) Customer to supply CSR & final IPs (emma) 3) Air-gap installer review + decide minio vs NFS (sre-oncall) 4) Small model variant + canary (ankit) 5) Runbook update and cert push (maria)

josh: Pinged NOC again — added note about maintenance window Wed-Fri 02:00-06:00 local.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist reminder: latest staging image build succeeded (build-2026-03-16-17).

emma: I'll coordinate with CS to nudge the customer for CSR and IPs. If we don't have handoff by EOD Fri, we should reschedule the Tue rollout.

maria: Agreed. I'll flag this as "at risk" on the rollout tracker and assign owners above. If anyone hits a blocker, drop a note here and mention @sre-oncall. :white_check_mark:

ankit: I'll post the installer PR link once ready for review: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/merge/432

josh: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short status update tomorrow morning.

sre-oncall: Adding one more note: ensure customers open ports 443 and 9901 inbound to the staging jumpbox, and allow outbound to our registry IPs. I'll paste the exact list in the runbook.
